cases.name: Workforce synthesis-only Skills
cases.prompt: Run three independent analyses -- latency, correctness, and isolation -- of the following checkout service, then synthesize. Service description: a FastAPI endpoint accepts a checkout request, calls a third-party payment gateway over HTTPS synchronously with a 5-second timeout and no retries, then writes the resulting transaction to a single shared PostgreSQL connection pool (pool size 10) in the same request before returning a confirmation to the caller. There is no message queue, no idempotency key on the payment call, and no per-tenant isolation of the connection pool.
